title: Managed Database: invoice grouping
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database invoice grouping is specified by contracted tier. Invoice grouping keys within the customer portfolio; string list. Default allocation of an unspecified remittance; deterministic string.

| Contracted tier | Invoice grouping | Collection order |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | legal billing entity; currency; period | invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | legal billing entity; currency; period | invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | legal billing entity; currency; period | invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | legal billing entity; currency; period | invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | legal billing entity; currency; period | invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | legal billing entity; currency; period | invoice issue time followed by original source reference |
